🅱️ Polite little white lies

Which world do you pick? 🅰️ Our world  🅱️ Delay world 👇
Fair answer! 😄 And time really does depend on height: in 2010, atomic clocks at NIST measured it tick faster when raised just 33 cm.

Would you trade sleep for 8 extra hours a day? 🅰️ Keep my sleep  🅱️ Never sleep 👇

jobs.title: Do Cats ALWAYS Land on Their Feet? 🌀 #Swirlverse
jobs.description:
Do cats always land on their feet? Almost! A falling cat bends in the middle, tucks its front paws, spins its front half, then swaps and spins the back half. But in this parallel world, cats can't bend... 🐱
Bendy cats or stiff cats? Comment below 👇

Real science: the cat righting reflex. The front and back halves turn in opposite directions, so the total spin (angular momentum) stays zero. It needs a super flexible spine. It isn't guaranteed: a very short drop is too quick to turn. Sources: Scientific American, Live Science.

jobs.title: Is Lightning HOTTER Than the Sun? 🌀 #Swirlverse
jobs.description:
Is lightning really hotter than the Sun? It depends! A lightning bolt can heat the air to about 27,000°C, about 5 times hotter than the Sun's surface (about 5,500°C). But the Sun's core is about 15 million °C, over 500 times hotter than lightning. And in this parallel world, lightning is only as hot as a candle flame... ⚡
Hot lightning or calm lightning? Comment below 👇

Real science: lightning superheats a narrow channel of air so fast that it expands with a bang, and that sound wave is thunder. The 27,000°C figure is a peak; parts of the channel are cooler. Sources: NOAA National Weather Service, NOAA NSSL, NASA, Britannica.

#shorts #science #lightning #sun #weather #swirlverse

jobs.title: Is 1 Dog Year REALLY 7 Human Years? 🌀 #Swirlverse
jobs.description:
Is one dog year really seven human years? Myth! A 1-year-old dog is already about 15 in human years, about 24 by age 2, and after that each dog year adds about 4 or 5 human years. Big dogs usually age faster than small dogs. But in this parallel world, every dog year is exactly 7 human years... 🐶
Fast puppies or slow puppies? Comment below 👇

Real science: vets use an age guideline (AVMA, shared by the American Kennel Club) instead of the old x7 rule, and a DNA study of Labradors at UC San Diego also found that dogs age very fast at first and then slow down. These are estimates: breed and size change them. Sources: American Kennel Club (AVMA guideline), Smithsonian Magazine, NHGRI (genome.gov).

#shorts #science #dogs #dogyears #animals #swirlverse
